communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写雅思 Task 1 或数据报告的第一段：用同义句法改写图表标题，并用两句话高度凝练全图最核心的 2 个宏观趋势（极值、反超拐点或主次格局），绝不堆砌零碎数字。
prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 1】假设你正在撰写【IELTS Academic Task 1 首段（Introduction + Overview）或实验趋势总览段】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想写雅思 Task 1 或数据报告的第一段：用同义句法改写图表标题，并用两句话高度凝练全图最核心的 2 个宏观趋势（极值、反超拐点或主次格局），绝不堆砌零碎数字。”。请严格按照 `BP25` 的逐句功能骨架（3 步法）与逻辑法则 `L025`（具身智能感知-决策-控制闭环与 Sim-to-Real 论证规范（Embodied AI Closed-Loop Logic）），写出一段 4–5 句、零 AI 痕迹、主语紧凑（≤6词）的自然英文段落。
source_material_or_draft: The chart shows the energy consumption from 2000 to 2025. We can see that solar energy went up a lot from 5% to 35%, and coal went down from 60% to 25%. Wind also went up.
structural_constraints: S1 [图表命题同义改写 Prompt Paraphrase]：The line graph / bar chart compares [Variable/Metric] across [Categories/Regions] over a [N]-year period from [Year A] to [Year B].
S2 [宏观趋势 1：总体走向与反超 Overview Trend 1]：Overall, while [Category A and B] experienced a steady upward trajectory, [Category C] declined markedly, leading to a reversal in dominance around [Mid-Year].
S3 [宏观趋势 2：极值或差距特征 Overview Trend 2]：Notably, [Category A] registered the most dramatic growth throughout the period, ultimately overtaking all other sectors to become the primary contributor.
